name: cyprussteps-desktop-demo
description: Desktop prototype of Cyprus Step-by-Step built with Next.js, TypeScript and Electron.
author: Nikita Glazkov

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "npm.cmd run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npm.cmd run electron:compile && electron ."
scripts.electron:prod: npm.cmd run electron:compile && set ELECTRON_STATIC=1&& electron .
scripts.package:win:portable: npm.cmd run build && npm.cmd run electron:compile && electron-builder --win portable --x64
